evidence: At 360x780, the header controls extend to x=412, 52 px beyond the screen. The profile image occupies x=364–396 and is entirely outside the initial view; the rest of the page remains 360 px wide. Screenshot: p01-phone-0.png.
fix: At the phone breakpoint, reduce navigation-link horizontal padding or move secondary actions into an overflow menu so the complete header fits within 360 px.

evidence: The header control row ends at x=364 in a 360 px viewport, making the document 4 px wider than the screen. The last profile control extends x=300–364, past the header edge. Screenshot: p02-phone-0.png.
fix: Reduce phone header spacing by at least 4 px and constrain the control row to the available width.

evidence: In the Interactive ribbon card near the bottom, the diagonal LINKED band crosses the first paragraph line and obscures the end of "inherits". The 110x110 ribbon wrapper occupies x=229–339, while paragraph text extends through the same area at document y≈2412–2434. Screenshot: p02-360-overlap.png.
fix: Reserve the ribbon corner in the paragraph layout: increase the top/right clearance or place the paragraph below the 110 px ribbon region on narrow screens.

evidence: The Navbar demo search input collapses to 26x38 px at x≈1303. Its 12 px padding on each side plus borders leaves essentially no text area, and its Search placeholder is invisible. The adjacent Search button is about 72 px wide. Screenshot: p03-final-check.png.
fix: Collapse this embedded navbar according to its container width, or wrap its search form onto another row and give the input a usable minimum width, such as 120 px.

evidence: In the Revenue Sources legend, the Referral dot stays on the first row at x≈287, y≈1277, but its label moves to x≈205, y≈1293. The icon and label are separated into different rows inside the 166 px legend container. Screenshot: p04-360-target-1040.png.
fix: Make each legend item an inline-flex or inline-block unit with white-space: nowrap, and allow wrapping between whole legend items.

evidence: At the page end, the fixed 44x44 px up-arrow control occupies x=300–344, y=720–764. The copyright text extends to x≈324 at y≈732–750, so the button covers roughly the last 24 px, including the end of the year. Screenshot: p04-360-target-4000.png.
fix: Reserve space for the floating control in the footer, or reposition the control above the footer so it cannot cover the copyright line.

evidence: At 360x780, the header action row ends at x=364, producing a 364 px document width. The final profile control extends 4 px beyond its 360 px header. Screenshot: p05-phone-0.png.
fix: Reduce phone navigation spacing by at least 4 px so the final profile control stays inside the viewport.

evidence: The search block drops beneath its search icon into a second header row at y=48–79, increasing the header to 88 px high while the other action icons remain at y=8–48. On phone its input is only about 53 px wide and visibly clips Search to "Sea"; on laptop the same block sits below the icon at x≈1038. Screenshots: p06-phone-0.png and p06-laptop-0.png.
fix: Keep the search form within a properly sized single-row header region or an explicitly positioned search overlay. Prevent its input from shrinking below a usable width.

evidence: The two-line empty-state message begins flush against x=0 inside a 360 px-wide empty-state panel. The heading box is 360x134 px, but its short lines remain left aligned instead of centered in that panel; the laptop message is centered. Screenshot: p06-phone-0.png.
fix: Apply text-align: center to the empty-state heading and add horizontal padding so wrapped lines remain centered and clear of the screen edge.

evidence: The phone header action row extends to x=412, 52 px past the 360 px screen. The profile image at x=364–396 is outside the visible screen, while the content card ends at x=340. Screenshot: p08-phone-0.png.
fix: Reduce phone header action spacing or move secondary actions into an overflow menu so all visible controls fit within 360 px.

evidence: The 900 px-high sidebar has a 56 px brand area and a roughly 49 px filter area, but its scroll wrapper is still 843 px high and starts at y≈105, ending at y≈948. After the page scrolls 48 px to its end, the sidebar surface ends at y=852 while a Mailbox menu row remains visible below it near y=870. Screenshot: p08-1440-target-10000.png.
fix: Size the sidebar scroll area from the remaining height after both brand and filter rows, for example with a column flex layout and flex: 1; min-height: 0. Keep its menu viewport inside the sidebar surface.

evidence: Both tables are approximately 521 px wide, starting at x=28 and ending at x≈549 inside 344 px-wide cards. The 360 px screen cuts off the right-hand columns, and the document becomes 549 px wide, adding about 189 px of sideways overflow. Screenshots: p09-phone-0.png and p09-phone-css-3.png.
fix: Place each table inside a width-constrained overflow-x: auto wrapper or use responsive column layouts. Contain horizontal scrolling within the table region rather than the page.

evidence: Both pagination rows start their Previous control at x≈-5, although their containers start at x=28. The control group is about 337 px wide inside a 304 px area, so its left border is clipped by the screen and it overhangs the card padding by about 33 px. Screenshot: p09-phone-css-3.png.
fix: Use fewer numbered page buttons on phones, reduce pagination padding, or wrap the controls while keeping the full group within its 304 px container.

evidence: The fifth task label drops beneath its checkbox and drag handle, beginning at x=52.5 instead of the sibling labels at x≈121.1. Its first line starts about 22 px below its own checkbox; the other task labels share a row with their controls. Screenshot: p10-phone-2.png.
fix: Use a flex or grid row with fixed-width handle and checkbox columns and a min-width: 0 text column, allowing the label to wrap within its own column.

evidence: All three documentation tables extend beyond the 320 px card and 360 px screen. They start at x=45 and measure approximately 798, 880, and 760 px wide; the largest ends at x≈925, making the document 565 px wider than the screen. Most right-hand columns are outside the visible view. Screenshots: p11-phone-0.png, p11-phone-css-7.png, and p11-phone-css-9.png.
fix: Wrap each table in a max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto container, or provide a responsive stacked table layout. Keep the card and document width constrained to the viewport.

evidence: The header actions end at x=364 in a 360 px viewport, causing 4 px of document-level horizontal overflow. The final profile control extends beyond the header edge. Screenshot: p12-phone-full.png.
fix: Reduce phone header spacing by at least 4 px and ensure the action row fits the available width.

evidence: In the Inbox card header, the fixed 256 px-wide search group wraps under the title but begins at x=75, y≈794.5. The title spans x=37–78.1 with a text line box at y≈777.8–802.8, leaving about 3 px horizontal and 8 px vertical overlap where the search border touches the final title glyph. Screenshot: p12-final-check.png.
fix: Use an explicit wrapping flex layout with a gap. At phone width, put the title and search group in separate full-width rows, remove the negative vertical offset on the search group, and let it fit the header content width.
